title: Sentinel-2 L2A product metadata (MTD_MSIL2A.xml) for the two 10SEH COG dates (2024-08-16, 2025-01-23)
source: Microsoft Planetary Computer, collection sentinel-2-l2a (asset product-metadata)
licence: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open)
profile: Product-level metadata with BOA_QUANTIFICATION_VALUE and BOA_ADD_OFFSET per band, for (DN + offset) / quantification reflectance
notes: Found with a Planetary Computer STAC search (sentinel-2-l2a, s2:mgrs_tile=10SEH, each date). Earth Search (sentinel-cogs) ships only granule_metadata.xml, not the product MTD. Unsigned blob URLs return 409; signed with the anonymous PC SAS token.

title: OpenDroneMap Bellus: 122 drone frames (EXIF GPS) with a surveyed ground-control list (gcp_list.txt, WGS 84 / UTM 17N)
profile: gcp_list.txt rows: easting northing elevation pixel_x pixel_y image (ODM format); RGB JPEG with EXIF GPS
notes: Found by listing OpenDroneMap odm_data_* repositories for a gcp_list.txt (odm_data_helenenschacht also has GCP/ and RTK data).

title: Landsat 7 ETM+ C2 L2 surface reflectance, path 44 row 34, 2021-06-17 (SLC-off: wedge-shaped scan-line gaps)
source: Microsoft Planetary Computer, collection landsat-c2-l2 (USGS Collection 2)
attribution: Landsat 7 image courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
profile: 6 SR bands (B1-B5, B7) at 30 m, QA_PIXEL with fill for the SLC-off gaps, UTM 10N; same path/row as the Landsat 8 items
notes: Found with a Planetary Computer STAC search (landsat-c2-l2, platform landsat-7, WRS 044/034, cloud < 5 %). The Scan Line Corrector failed on 2003-05-31; every later ETM+ scene has ~22 % no-data stripes, the destripe/fill test case.

title: GDAL autotest: DIMAP v2 packages (Pléiades bundle, Pléiades Neo RPC, single component, VHR2020 MS-FS), RPF zone 9 (A.TOC + CADRG frame), masked NITF IC=NM (NITF 2.1 and NSIF)
format: DIMAP v2 (DIM_*.XML + IMG tiles + RPC), RPF A.TOC + CADRG, NITF/NSIF IC=NM
profile: Small structural test packages written for GDAL's DIMAP and RPFTOC drivers; DIM/RPC XML follow the Airbus DIMAP v2 layout; i_3034f / ns3034d are JITC masked (IC=NM) files
notes: File list from the GitHub tree at v3.13.3. i_3034f/ns3034d are also in robustness-gdal-autotest-seeds, which the census reads header-only; here they count as valid IC=NM samples. Real Airbus DIMAP v2 products need the Airbus sample form (tier B).

title: EO-1 Hyperion L1T, path 43 row 34 (Central Valley CA), 2017-03-12: 242 band GeoTIFFs + MTL
licence: Public domain (USGS); free USGS ERS login required
attribution: EO-1 Hyperion data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
profile: 242 bands 357-2576 nm, 30 m, UTM, Int16 scaled radiance; pushbroom column striping in the SWIR bands
notes: Downloaded through the owner's EarthExplorer session (account gisworkbench) on 2026-10-29: dataset 'EO-1 Hyperion' (5e83a1255d5fa4fd), entity EO1H0430342017071110KF_AS1_01, 'L1T Product in GeoTiff format' (product 5e83a12e55409b90). Classic destripe target (per-detector column striping); the L1R HDF4 product was not taken (the app reads HDF5 only).
